messages:
kenji: quick heads-up — rolled out the Tidal Batcher to canary (10% of runtime traffic)  
kenji: config: dynamic-window=auto, max_batch=48, eager-evict=false  
deploy-bot: canary deploy 1715001234 -> green on 3 hosts :white_check_mark:  
maya: do we have bench numbers yet?  
kenji: run a short 1k qps sweep; saw ~32% p50 improvement vs baseline and ~12% unit-cost reduction on that workload  
ali: nice. p99 impact?  
kenji: p99 roughly flat (+1-3% in most slices). important: tail didn't regress in CPU-constrained profiles  
sarah: can you paste the quick summary shard?  
kenji: sure — sample run against redwood-small, seq=512, warmup 2m:  
kenji: ```
kenji: ./bench.sh --model=redwood-small --qps=1000 --seq=512
kenji: baseline: p50=120ms, p95=420ms, p99=720ms, cost/unit=1.00
kenji: tidal-canary: p50=82ms, p95=400ms, p99=708ms, cost/unit=0.88
kenji: overall: p50 -31.7%, cost -12%
kenji: ```  
maya: impressive p50 drop. any workload types where it regresses?  
kenji: some tiny regressions on ultra-short seq=8 workloads where batching overhead dominates; we added a short-request bypass to handle that in the next patch  
ali: what about KV cache hit interplay? did prefetching cause extra memory churn?  
kenji: we limited prefetch window when mem pressure > 70% and that avoided churn. KV hitrate unchanged in the canary slice  
sarah: ops: when do we flip to 100%?  
kenji: plan: ramp 10% -> 30% after 1h stable metrics, then -> 100% over 6h if p99 and error rates OK. I'll monitor dashboards.  
maya: add alert for retry spike and model-queue-latency > 2x baseline  
kenji: will do. added a short incident runbook in the rollout doc: https://go/redwood/tidal-batcher-rollout  
deploy-bot: traffic ramp: 10% -> 30% at 1715001334 :rocket:  
ali: thumbs up from infra — no infra-level regressions on GPU utilization  
kenji: also pushed a small opt in the kernel selector: favors compact-kernel for seq<=64 which gives extra savings for small batched requests  
sarah: can we get a short blurb for all-hands tomorrow? ops win + econ numbers  
kenji: yes — i'll draft a 2-slide summary (what changed, numbers, rollout plan, next steps). ping me if you want edits.  
maya: love it. congrats team :tada:  
kenji: thanks — big props to ali for the prefetch heuristics and to infra for the smooth canary  
ali: team effort!  
deploy-bot: final ramp to 100% scheduled at 1715001534 — monitoring window open :eyes:
